name: octo-claw
description: Multi-agent orchestration with Double Diamond methodology. Brings 8 workflow tools — discover, define, develop, deliver, embrace, debate, review, security — plus skill listing and status introspection to OpenClaw.

enabledWorkflows.description: Which Octopus workflows to expose as OpenClaw tools.
